scripts.ios:build: node -e "const app=require('./app.json'); const name=app.rune.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, ''); const workspace=require('fs').readdirSync('ios').find(f=>f.endsWith('.xcworkspace')); console.log('Building', name, 'workspace:', workspace); process.exit(0)" && xcodebuild -workspace ios/*.xcworkspace -scheme {{XCODE_SCHEME}} -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/.build
scripts.ios:run: xcrun simctl bootstatus booted -b && xcrun simctl install booted ios/.build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/{{XCODE_SCHEME}}.app && xcrun simctl launch booted {{BUNDLE_ID}}
scripts.ios:logs: xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --style compact --level debug --predicate 'process == "{{XCODE_SCHEME}}" AND (eventMessage BEGINSWITH "[SN]" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "JS Error")'
scripts.ios:dev: (yarn ios:logs &) && yarn build && yarn ios:build && yarn ios:run
scripts.android:dev: yarn build && yarn android:install && yarn android:run
